description: Real Solana vulnerabilities, taken from the maintainers' own fix commit and its parent. The answer key is the fix, written by the project's own developers in response to a public disclosure. We do not decide what the bug was.
acceptance_criteria: a merged commit or PR that fixed the bug
the code as it stood before that commit, reachable as the parent
a public description of the bug, so the label is not our opinion
caveat: File paths are derived from each fix commit rather than typed in, but the packaging is ours: each variant is extracted into a minimal crate so scanners will parse it. That is not how the code exists in the real project and may affect analysis that depends on crate context. Superseded in part: files are now pinned per case rather than taken wholesale from the commit.

cases.name: wormhole-sysvar
cases.note: Instructions sysvar read without verifying the account address; fix switches to the _checked variants.
cases.contamination_note: The fix commit is a monorepo-wide dependency bump (solana-program 1.7.0 to 1.9.4) plus a compiler attribute change across every crate. It touches 12 .rs files; only this one contains the security fix. The other 11 were noise in the first build.

cases.name: cashio-account-data
cases.note: Missing assert that the bank's crate mint matches the supplied crate mint.
cases.contamination_note: programs/brrr/src/lib.rs in the same commit is a kill switch (invariant!(false)) disabling print_cash and burn_cash, not a logic fix. Excluded.
cases.invalid_reason: NOT A VALID PAIR. Commit 7df65818 does not fix the vulnerability: it adds vipers::invariant!(false, "temporarily disabled") to print_cash and burn_cash, which disables the program. It is an emergency shutdown, not a security fix. Verified by reading the diff and by git log: only three commits in the repository's history ever touched programs/brrr/src/lib.rs, the last of them is this one, and every commit after the exploit date is a dependency bump. Cashio never shipped a fix because the protocol was shut down. Consequence: the 'secure' variant is dead code, so findings disappear from it for reasons unrelated to the vulnerability, and any detection credited on this pair would be spurious. Found 2026-08-31 while checking why Radar produced 23 insecure-only findings on the real crate. EXCLUDED FROM ALL SCORING. Kept in the manifest so the error is visible rather than deleted from the record.

cases.name: spl-token-lending-rounding
cases.sha_correction: The manifest first carried bf15464783aca0395d953165b68b143c4b8c984f, the head of PR #1883's branch. That is a MERGE commit with two parents, and `git show` on a merge without -m prints the combined diff, which omits files identical to either parent. rate.rs and reserve.rs matched the feature-branch parent exactly, so the diff appeared empty and the case was dropped. We recorded the cause as 'almost certainly an artefact of shallow cloning'. That guess was wrong and was disproved by testing it. The correct SHA is the squash-merge commit, which has a single parent.

cases.name: squads-account-matching
cases.contamination_note: The commit also deletes dead commented-out constraints in the same file. Unrelated to the flaw, but unavoidable since it is the same file.

cases.name: metaplex-token-metadata
cases.contamination_note: assertions/misc.rs in the same commit adds assert_keys_equal_with_error, which is never called in this diff. Dead code added ahead of use. Excluded.

cases.name: metaplex-bubblegum-creator
cases.contamination_note: The noisiest case. The fix spans two packages and is bundled with unrelated hardening of assert_collection_update_is_valid and an unrelated v2-to-v3 API change. compression.rs is new in the fix, so it has no vulnerable counterpart and only metadata.rs forms a pair.

cases.name: anchor-interface-account
cases.note: A vulnerability in the framework itself rather than in a program built with it.
cases.contamination_note: The other files in the commit are a newly added test-fixture program plus CI and build config.

excluded.anchor-program-system: CVE-2026-45137. The only reference we have is a release commit rather than a surgical fix, so the pair would not isolate the change. Needs the actual fixing commit in lang/src/accounts/program.rs before it can be used.

file_selection: Each case pins the file the public disclosure actually implicates, established by reading every fix commit's full diff against its advisory. The first build took every .rs file the commit touched, which packaged dependency bumps, kill switches, dead code and unrelated hardening as part of a vulnerability pair. Recorded in KNOWN-LIMITATIONS as limitation 3.
scoring_note: Cases with valid=false are excluded from every denominator. As of 2026-08-31 that is cashio-account-data only, leaving 9 valid cases of the 10 built.
